title: Descemet Membrane Endothelial Keratoplasty for Corneal Decompensation Secondary to Phakic Intraocular Lenses
indication: Corneal decompensation (bullous keratopathy) secondary to phakic IOLs implanted 7-21 years earlier (Artisan iris-fixated 4, I-Care angle-supported 2, GBR/Vivarte angle-supported 1); mild to moderate cataract in all eyes; high myopia

groups.description: Two-step bilensectomy (phakic IOL explantation and phacoemulsification with IOL) followed by Melles no-touch DMEK with 20% SF6 tamponade 1-26 months later (patients 1-3 and 5-7; bilensectomy elsewhere for patients 5 and 7), or a same-day quadruple procedure (patient 4); grafts prepared by the surgeon; retrospective case series, Valencia

exclusions.reason: Primary graft failure after the quadruple procedure; no postoperative ECD reading, so only the donor value exists and no follow-up series can be formed

exclusions.what: Group means and percent losses in the Results text and in parentheses of Table 2 cells
exclusions.reason: Per-eye rows exist, so individual series are used; absolute ECD is read from each cell
ECD of the recipient's decompensated cornea before keratoplasty, not the donor reference
No value reported; omitted from the individual series (never back-filled)

notes: Role: standard DMEK after bilensectomy without an investigational agent; single control-role group with one individual series per eye.
Table 2 data rows have 17 cells (patient, UCVA x5, BCVA x5, refraction, ECD x5); empty spacer rows (R4, R6, R8, R10, R12, R14) are counted in the R numbering.
Reference kind donor_other: the donor ECD 'before DMEK preparation' is reported without stating who counted it.
